clean.tx: ʿUa tuku ia te tama ʿi te kui
clean.tl: He gave the child to the mother.' (direct-object marking is omitted in imperatives, and also if there may be some confusion between direct and indirect)

clean.tx: Tae he mōrore te poki nei, āau mau te poki nei.
clean.tl: This child is not a bastard, the child is your own.

clean.tx: Tae ko Reŋa Roiti taa mee ena.
clean.tl: That one (lit. ‘your thing’) is not Renga Roiti.
